user_query: I want to expand my shoe collection by finding unique and rare shoes along with their details and a reliable online store to purchase them.

TaskList.description: Search for unique and rare shoe collections with prices, images, descriptions, quantities, and ratings.
Extract detailed information for each shoe found, including prices, images, descriptions, quantities, and ratings.
Identify reliable online stores that offer the shoes from the collected list.
Gather reviews and ratings for the identified online stores to ensure reliability.
Compile a final list of shoes with their details and reliable online stores to purchase from.
